decisive_items: Diffuse ground-glass opacity, mosaic attenuation, and ill-defined centrilobular nodules
Krebs von den Lungen-6 level: 1250 U/mL
response.rationale: C1 supplies the causative agent missing from R5 and best fits the recurrent interstitial CT pattern appearing 15 weeks after each TC treatment, with elevated KL-6 and BAL lymphocytosis. R5 is the same diagnosis but lacks the TC etiologic specificity. HP is disfavored by negative anti-T. asahii and absent antigen exposure; radiation pneumonitis is unsupported because no radiotherapy is mentioned; OP and LIP are less specific and lack causal anchoring.

rejected.why: No radiation therapy or chest irradiation is mentioned; the supporting spans are nonspecific and do not establish radiation exposure.

Mosaic attenuation and centrilobular nodules plus BAL lymphocytosis suggest HP, but anti-T. asahii is negative and no causative antigen exposure is described; TC chemotherapy timing better explains the episodes.
Ground-glass opacity and centrilobular nodules are nonspecific, and the BAL lymphocytosis, elevated KL-6, and drug exposure are more consistent with drug-induced pneumonitis.
No raw support spans are supplied, and BAL lymphocytosis alone cannot diagnose lymphocytic interstitial pneumonia without typical CT features and supportive clinical context.
